tools.name: answer_popup
tools.description: Answer a JS dialog (alert/confirm/prompt), a permission request (camera/location/notifications), or a file chooser. Answer first: every other page act stalls while one is open.

spec.name: answer_popup

tools.name: audio_extract
tools.description: An audio extraction tool that pulls the audio track out of a video file INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace (or project/Data/files) using FFmpeg and saves it as mp3 or wav in the Workspace. Use whenever you need audio-only from a video (downloaded via video_download or uploaded) for transcription, listening, or further analysis. Returns the saved audio path plus duration and size metadata.

spec.name: audio_extract
spec.description: An audio extraction tool that pulls the audio track out of a video file INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace (or project/Data/files) using FFmpeg and saves it as mp3 or wav in the Workspace. Use whenever you need audio-only from a video (downloaded via video_download or uploaded) for transcription, listening, or further analysis. Returns the saved audio path plus duration and size metadata.

video_path.description: Workspace-relative path of the source video (e.g. returned by video_download).

audio_format.description: Output audio format: mp3 (default, small) or wav (16k mono, STT-ready).

output_name.description: Optional custom audio file name inside Workspace (single name, extension added if missing).

tools.name: batch_actions
tools.description: Run several navigation/interaction tools in one call, stopping at the first error. Use for known, safe step chains to save loop cycles. Keep page-changing steps last: refs must stay valid.

spec.name: batch_actions
spec.description: Run several navigation/interaction tools in one call, stopping at the first error. Use for known, safe step chains to save loop cycles. Keep page-changing steps last: refs must stay valid.

actions.description: Max 20 steps: each {tool, args} with a known browser tool name.

stop_on_error.description: Stop at first error. Default true.

tools.name: browser_status
tools.description: Report the browser state without starting anything: running or closed, uptime, who owns control, and the current live links. Read-only: answers 'stopped' without starting the browser when it is down.

spec.name: browser_status
spec.description: Report the browser state without starting anything: running or closed, uptime, who owns control, and the current live links. Read-only: answers 'stopped' without starting the browser when it is down.

tools.name: choose_option
tools.description: Pick a dropdown value: native select or custom list (opens it and picks by itself). Verifies the value really changed; fails with select_failed otherwise.

spec.name: choose_option
spec.description: Pick a dropdown value: native select or custom list (opens it and picks by itself). Verifies the value really changed; fails with select_failed otherwise.

multiple.description: Values to select in a multi-select list.

tools.name: click_verify
tools.description: Click like click(), then check conditions like verify_state() in one call. Use after every click that must land somewhere: one roundtrip, one final picture. Fails when the click fails (verify skipped) or any check fails.

spec.name: click_verify
spec.description: Click like click(), then check conditions like verify_state() in one call. Use after every click that must land somewhere: one roundtrip, one final picture. Fails when the click fails (verify skipped) or any check fails.

x.description: Viewport x in px (alternative to ref).

y.description: Viewport y in px (alternative to ref).

button.description: left, right or middle. Default left.

modifiers.description: Modifiers held with the click: ctrl, shift, alt, meta.

tools.name: close_browser
tools.description: Close the browser quietly and keep its data (profile, cookies, tabs on disk). The live link of this session dies with it: it answers Not Connect, and the next tool call starts a new session with a new link.

spec.name: close_browser
spec.description: Close the browser quietly and keep its data (profile, cookies, tabs on disk). The live link of this session dies with it: it answers Not Connect, and the next tool call starts a new session with a new link.

tools.name: console_command
tools.description: Run one JavaScript command in the page console and answer its value (define/spy/read a variable, last-resort fixes). Real input events stay the way to drive a page. Needs human approval first when approvals are on.

spec.name: console_command
spec.description: Run one JavaScript command in the page console and answer its value (define/spy/read a variable, last-resort fixes). Real input events stay the way to drive a page. Needs human approval first when approvals are on.

script.description: JS expression or statements, max 5000 chars.

ref.description: Run it with the element as this.

tools.name: document_search
tools.description: Semantic search inside ONE uploaded document file (Workspace file_id). Supported files: PDF (.pdf), Word (.docx/.doc), Excel (.xlsx/.xls/.csv), PowerPoint (.pptx/.ppt), and text/data (.txt/.md/.html/.json/.xml). The file is converted to organized markdown via MarkItDown, split into 300-word chunks, and embedded — scanned PDF pages with almost no text are transcribed by the vision model first. Call with the Workspace file_id (e.g. report.pdf), a query sentence to compare, and how many chunks to return (top_k, min 1). The file_id MUST be a supported type or the call is rejected — check the Workspace block or list first.

spec.name: document_search
spec.description: Semantic search inside ONE uploaded document file (Workspace file_id). Supported files: PDF (.pdf), Word (.docx/.doc), Excel (.xlsx/.xls/.csv), PowerPoint (.pptx/.ppt), and text/data (.txt/.md/.html/.json/.xml). The file is converted to organized markdown via MarkItDown, split into 300-word chunks, and embedded — scanned PDF pages with almost no text are transcribed by the vision model first. Call with the Workspace file_id (e.g. report.pdf), a query sentence to compare, and how many chunks to return (top_k, min 1). The file_id MUST be a supported type or the call is rejected — check the Workspace block or list first.

file_id.description: Workspace-relative document path, e.g. report.pdf or docs/budget.xlsx. Must be a supported type.

query.description: Sentence to compare against the document chunks.

top_k.description: How many chunks to return. Default 3, minimum 1.

tools.name: drag_drop
tools.description: Drag an element to another spot with gradual moves (sliders, maps). Accepts refs or coordinates. Ends in different frames fail with invalid_input.

spec.name: drag_drop
spec.description: Drag an element to another spot with gradual moves (sliders, maps). Accepts refs or coordinates. Ends in different frames fail with invalid_input.

tools.name: embedding_memory
tools.description: A semantic text memory that stores one text as a local embedding chunk and retrieves the most similar chunks for a query sentence. Provide text to store, or query to retrieve stored chunks only. Bounded (500 entries), persistent across restarts.

spec.name: embedding_memory
spec.description: A semantic text memory that stores one text as a local embedding chunk and retrieves the most similar chunks for a query sentence. Provide text to store, or query to retrieve stored chunks only. Bounded (500 entries), persistent across restarts.

reason.description: Why you call this tool (max 15 words, English).

text.description: Text to store as one embedding chunk (max 2000 chars). Provide this to store.

query.description: Sentence that retrieves stored embedding chunks only. Provide this to search.

top_k.description: How many chunks to return (1-10, default 5). For search only.

tools.name: export_page
tools.description: Save the current page as PDF, MHTML or HTML inside the workspace. Use to keep proof, a report or a page copy. Needs human approval first when approvals are on.

spec.name: export_page
spec.description: Save the current page as PDF, MHTML or HTML inside the workspace. Use to keep proof, a report or a page copy. Needs human approval first when approvals are on.

tools.name: extract_data
tools.description: Table, list, links, forms, images or meta of the page/element as structured JSON. Use to extract a table or link list instead of reading long text and parsing it yourself.

spec.name: extract_data
spec.description: Table, list, links, forms, images or meta of the page/element as structured JSON. Use to extract a table or link list instead of reading long text and parsing it yourself.

ref.description: One element only; omit for the whole page.

kind.description: table, list, links, forms, images or meta.

tools.name: extract_image
tools.description: Original image bytes by element ref or URL (QR codes, photos): the resource itself, not a re-render. Find the URL with extract_data(kind="images") or read_markdown first. For on-screen views use screenshot.

spec.name: extract_image
spec.description: Original image bytes by element ref or URL (QR codes, photos): the resource itself, not a re-render. Find the URL with extract_data(kind="images") or read_markdown first. For on-screen views use screenshot.

src.description: Image http(s) or data: URL (exactly one of ref|src).

tools.name: fetch_pages
tools.description: Fetch 1..5 page URLs as clean organized Markdown (title plus text, links resolved). Really visits each page, scrolls for lazy content, then filters nav/cookie/footer noise. One hidden tab per URL, all at once, each closed afterwards; failures come back per URL.

spec.name: fetch_pages
spec.description: Fetch 1..5 page URLs as clean organized Markdown (title plus text, links resolved). Really visits each page, scrolls for lazy content, then filters nav/cookie/footer noise. One hidden tab per URL, all at once, each closed afterwards; failures come back per URL.

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Fill several fields in order in one step, understanding each field type (text, checkbox, select), optionally pressing a submit button last. Stops at the first failing field and names it. Needs human approval first when approvals are on.

spec.name: fill_form
spec.description: Fill several fields in order in one step, understanding each field type (text, checkbox, select), optionally pressing a submit button last. Stops at the first failing field and names it. Needs human approval first when approvals are on.

fields.description: List of {ref, value}; value is text, true or false. Max 30 fields.

tools.name: find_elements
tools.description: Search live elements by name and optional role; returns refs directly so no snapshot is needed first. Use when you know the button or field name and want to skip a long map, or to inspect why a click keeps failing.

spec.name: find_elements
spec.description: Search live elements by name and optional role; returns refs directly so no snapshot is needed first. Use when you know the button or field name and want to skip a long map, or to inspect why a click keeps failing.

query.description: Element name or substring to search for.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Events since last check: new tab, open JS dialog, permission request, file chooser, started download, navigation, page crash. Use when an act gives an unexpected result or any press may have opened something.

spec.name: get_events
spec.description: Events since last check: new tab, open JS dialog, permission request, file chooser, started download, navigation, page crash. Use when an act gives an unexpected result or any press may have opened something.

types.description: Filter: new_tab, dialog_open, permission_request, file_chooser, download_started, navigation, page_crash.

tools.name: get_page_info
tools.description: One-glance page/tab state: URL, title, load readiness, control owner, viewport, scroll position, page height, iframe count, focused element, open popup. Call before acting to confirm control is still agent. Read-only: answers 'stopped' without starting the browser when it is down.

spec.name: get_page_info
spec.description: One-glance page/tab state: URL, title, load readiness, control owner, viewport, scroll position, page height, iframe count, focused element, open popup. Call before acting to confirm control is still agent. Read-only: answers 'stopped' without starting the browser when it is down.

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Move the mouse gradually over an element. Use for hover-only menus and tooltips. Returns the newly appeared elements.

spec.name: hover
spec.description: Move the mouse gradually over an element. Use for hover-only menus and tooltips. Returns the newly appeared elements.

x.description: Viewport x in px (alternative to ref).

y.description: Viewport y in px (alternative to ref).

tools.name: hover_click
tools.description: Hover a menu to open it, then click its item, in one call. Use for hover-only menus whose options appear only after hovering. One roundtrip, one final picture.

spec.name: hover_click
spec.description: Hover a menu to open it, then click its item, in one call. Use for hover-only menus whose options appear only after hovering. One roundtrip, one final picture.

target_ref.description: Item to click after the menu opens.

tools.name: http_request
tools.description: A generic HTTP client that performs a GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE request to any http(s) URL and returns the status plus response text. Use to fetch page/API content, call REST endpoints, or talk to an MCP server URL (initialize, tools/list, tools/call via JSON-RPC body). Send whatever the target needs: any headers and any text or JSON body on any method.

spec.name: http_request
spec.description: A generic HTTP client that performs a GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE request to any http(s) URL and returns the status plus response text. Use to fetch page/API content, call REST endpoints, or talk to an MCP server URL (initialize, tools/list, tools/call via JSON-RPC body). Send whatever the target needs: any headers and any text or JSON body on any method.

method.description: HTTP method: GET (default), POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE.

url.description: Target URL, http:// or https:// only (any public or local MCP/server URL).

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers as string pairs (e.g. Authorization, Content-Type, MCP-Session-Id).

body.description: Optional request body on any method: raw text or JSON string (MCP JSON-RPC payload, REST data, form, XML). Empty means no body.

tools.name: image_memory
tools.description: An image metadata management tool that stores, updates, retrieves, and clears persistent or temporary visual metadata and analysis notes. Use whenever image analysis results or visual references need to be remembered across conversation turns. Use this to maintain long-term visual memory and avoid redundant image reprocessing.

spec.name: image_memory
spec.description: An image metadata management tool that stores, updates, retrieves, and clears persistent or temporary visual metadata and analysis notes. Use whenever image analysis results or visual references need to be remembered across conversation turns. Use this to maintain long-term visual memory and avoid redundant image reprocessing.

image_id.description: ID of the image. Auto-generated if not provided on store.

vision_text.description: Vision analysis text for the image.

is_persistent.description: Whether image is persistent (sent every request). Default true.

tools.name: important_memory
tools.description: A high-priority fact memory tool that saves, lists, and deletes essential user rules, durable project constraints, and key facts. Use whenever the user explicitly communicates vital requirements, fixed preferences, or critical project settings that must survive across sessions. Use this to ensure essential constraints remain permanently accessible across conversation turns.

spec.name: important_memory
spec.description: A high-priority fact memory tool that saves, lists, and deletes essential user rules, durable project constraints, and key facts. Use whenever the user explicitly communicates vital requirements, fixed preferences, or critical project settings that must survive across sessions. Use this to ensure essential constraints remain permanently accessible across conversation turns.

content.description: Fact content to store. Required for store/update.

key.description: Optional key or title for the fact.

fact_id.description: ID of the fact. Required for update/delete/get.

tools.name: inspect_element
tools.description: Deep diagnosis of one element: type, attributes, state (visible, enabled, checked, value), box, covering element and HTML. Use when the map is not enough or a click keeps failing.

spec.name: inspect_element
spec.description: Deep diagnosis of one element: type, attributes, state (visible, enabled, checked, value), box, covering element and HTML. Use when the map is not enough or a click keeps failing.

include.description: Subset of attributes, state, box, styles, parents, html.

tools.name: list_requests
tools.description: Network capture is always on: one line per request (method, URL, status, type, size, duration, id). Pass id to get one request in full detail. Use to check network requests.

spec.name: list_requests
spec.description: Network capture is always on: one line per request (method, URL, status, type, size, duration, id). Pass id to get one request in full detail. Use to check network requests.

resource_type.description: document, xhr, fetch, script, image or websocket.

since_last_action.description: Only requests since the last action. Default false.

id.description: One request id for full detail.

parts.description: With id: request_headers, request_body, response_headers, response_body, timing, redirects, initiator.

tools.name: live_preview
tools.description: Watch-only live link (no remote input at all) + JSON, for a monitor screen or a read-only embed. Use to let the user watch without touching.

spec.name: live_preview
spec.description: Watch-only live link (no remote input at all) + JSON, for a monitor screen or a read-only embed. Use to let the user watch without touching.

tools.name: manage_downloads
tools.description: List downloads with state/size/path, wait for one to finish, or cancel a running one. Use after pressing a download link.

spec.name: manage_downloads
spec.description: List downloads with state/size/path, wait for one to finish, or cancel a running one. Use after pressing a download link.

tools.name: manage_tabs

spec.name: manage_tabs
spec.description: List tabs, open one, switch between them, or close one. Use after a new-tab event or when a popup appears.

id.description: Tab id from list (required with switch/close).

tools.name: manage_triggers
tools.description: List, start, update, or stop page-monitor triggers. Each trigger watches its own hidden tab on its own cadence while you work; it fires once and dies. list shows every running trigger; update edits one.

spec.name: manage_triggers
spec.description: List, start, update, or stop page-monitor triggers. Each trigger watches its own hidden tab on its own cadence while you work; it fires once and dies. list shows every running trigger; update edits one.

url.description: http(s) site to watch (required with start).

tools.name: press_keys
tools.description: Press a real key or combo: Enter, Tab, Esc, arrows, shortcuts. Fails with invalid_key on a bad name.

spec.name: press_keys
spec.description: Press a real key or combo: Enter, Tab, Esc, arrows, shortcuts. Fails with invalid_key on a bad name.

keys.description: Key or combo, e.g. Enter, Shift+Tab, Ctrl+A.

tools.name: quick_search
tools.description: Fast Google search as organized JSON (title, url, snippet per result). Reads up to 5 live result pages in a hidden tab that is closed afterwards; your tabs, refs and map stay untouched. For opening a result use navigate or manage_tabs.

spec.name: quick_search
spec.description: Fast Google search as organized JSON (title, url, snippet per result). Reads up to 5 live result pages in a hidden tab that is closed afterwards; your tabs, refs and map stay untouched. For opening a result use navigate or manage_tabs.

tools.name: read_console
tools.description: Console output (log/info/warn/error plus uncaught exceptions); the last 500 messages are captured automatically from page load. Use when a button does nothing, a page is blank, or a form never submits.

spec.name: read_console
spec.description: Console output (log/info/warn/error plus uncaught exceptions); the last 500 messages are captured automatically from page load. Use when a button does nothing, a page is blank, or a form never submits.

level.description: all, error, warn, info, log, debug or exception.

since.description: last_action or a message id: only newer messages.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: A filesystem inspection tool that reads and returns the full text content of a specified file INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only (any path outside is BLOCKED). Use whenever you need to examine workspace code, review workspace configs, or inspect workspace logs before taking action. Use this to verify ground-truth file contents and eliminate blind assumptions.

spec.name: read_file
spec.description: A filesystem inspection tool that reads and returns the full text content of a specified file INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only (any path outside is BLOCKED). Use whenever you need to examine workspace code, review workspace configs, or inspect workspace logs before taking action. Use this to verify ground-truth file contents and eliminate blind assumptions.

tools.name: read_markdown
tools.description: Full page or element text as organized Markdown (headings, lists, tables, links, form labels). Text only, no markup; uncapped by default whatever its size.

spec.name: read_markdown
spec.description: Full page or element text as organized Markdown (headings, lists, tables, links, form labels). Text only, no markup; uncapped by default whatever its size.

ref.description: One element only; omit for the whole page.

tools.name: read_text
tools.description: Visible text of the whole page or of one element. Use to read articles, search results or error messages. Long text is cut with a truncated marker.

spec.name: read_text
spec.description: Visible text of the whole page or of one element. Use to read articles, search results or error messages. Long text is cut with a truncated marker.

ref.description: One element only; omit for the whole page.

tools.name: restart_browser
tools.description: Close and start the browser again on the same profile (same tabs data kept on disk). Answers state only, no picture. Idempotent: restarting a closed browser simply starts it. Live links are renewed, so the UI shows a fresh preview automatically.

spec.name: restart_browser
spec.description: Close and start the browser again on the same profile (same tabs data kept on disk). Answers state only, no picture. Idempotent: restarting a closed browser simply starts it. Live links are renewed, so the UI shows a fresh preview automatically.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Viewport, element or full-page capture. Use for canvas, nameless icons or visual confirmation, or to click by coordinates. annotate=true draws ref numbers onto the image.

spec.name: screenshot
spec.description: Viewport, element or full-page capture. Use for canvas, nameless icons or visual confirmation, or to click by coordinates. annotate=true draws ref numbers onto the image.

ref.description: One element only; omit for viewport.

full_page.description: Capture the full page. Default false.

annotate.description: Draw ref numbers on the image. Default false.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page or a scrollable element with a real wheel, jump to one element (sticky-header aware), or go to an edge for infinite-scroll pages.

spec.name: scroll
spec.description: Scroll the page or a scrollable element with a real wheel, jump to one element (sticky-header aware), or go to an edge for infinite-scroll pages.

to_edge.description: top or bottom of the page.

container_ref.description: Scroll inside this element, not the page.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: A workspace file locator tool that searches INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only (any path outside is BLOCKED) for file paths matching glob patterns or content queries. Use whenever you need to locate workspace files, examine workspace layouts, or find code references across workspace folders. Use this to pinpoint exact target paths before reading or editing files.

spec.name: search_files
spec.description: A workspace file locator tool that searches INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only (any path outside is BLOCKED) for file paths matching glob patterns or content queries. Use whenever you need to locate workspace files, examine workspace layouts, or find code references across workspace folders. Use this to pinpoint exact target paths before reading or editing files.

query.description: Text to search for inside matched files.

tools.name: show_preview
tools.description: Show the browser to the user in the floating watch-only preview window (no control handed over) and answer its link. Call it when the user should watch what you are doing. Idempotent: if that same preview is already on screen nothing reopens.

spec.name: show_preview
spec.description: Show the browser to the user in the floating watch-only preview window (no control handed over) and answer its link. Call it when the user should watch what you are doing. Idempotent: if that same preview is already on screen nothing reopens.

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: A text-to-speech tool that converts written text into a spoken wav voice recording using the local Supertonic-3 model with the project's single fixed custom voice (a deep, calm, JARVIS-like male voice that sounds the same in Arabic + English, no cloud). Use whenever the user asks to hear text read aloud or wants a voice message. Saves the wav under X5Agent/Data/files/audio and returns its path plus duration so it plays as a WhatsApp-style voice record inside the chat. Keep text short (one message, max 1000 chars).

spec.name: text_to_speech
spec.description: A text-to-speech tool that converts written text into a spoken wav voice recording using the local Supertonic-3 model with the project's single fixed custom voice (a deep, calm, JARVIS-like male voice that sounds the same in Arabic + English, no cloud). Use whenever the user asks to hear text read aloud or wants a voice message. Saves the wav under X5Agent/Data/files/audio and returns its path plus duration so it plays as a WhatsApp-style voice record inside the chat. Keep text short (one message, max 1000 chars).

voice.description: Fixed project voice (nova). The voice is always the same; any other value is ignored.

tools.name: upload_files
tools.description: Attach one or more workspace files to a file field without opening the OS picker. Paths outside the workspace fail with path_forbidden. Needs human approval first when approvals are on.

spec.name: upload_files
spec.description: Attach one or more workspace files to a file field without opening the OS picker. Paths outside the workspace fail with path_forbidden. Needs human approval first when approvals are on.

tools.name: verify_state
tools.description: Check several conditions at once and get pass/fail per check. Cheaper and more precise than a screenshot or snapshot for confirming your last act worked.

spec.name: verify_state
spec.description: Check several conditions at once and get pass/fail per check. Cheaper and more precise than a screenshot or snapshot for confirming your last act worked.

tools.name: video_analyze
tools.description: An asynchronous video inspection tool that extracts keyframes across a video timeline and performs vision analysis per frame. Use whenever a video file requires visual content analysis, object detection, or temporal scene summarization. Use this to inspect complex temporal visual data reliably without overloading system memory.

spec.name: video_analyze
spec.description: An asynchronous video inspection tool that extracts keyframes across a video timeline and performs vision analysis per frame. Use whenever a video file requires visual content analysis, object detection, or temporal scene summarization. Use this to inspect complex temporal visual data reliably without overloading system memory.

job_id.description: Job ID to poll status. If provided, returns job status.

tools.name: video_download
tools.description: A video download tool that fetches a public video from a URL (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and hundreds of sites via yt-dlp) and saves the mp4 file INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only. Use whenever the user gives a video link that must be analyzed. Returns the saved workspace path plus video metadata (title, uploader, duration, resolution) so the next step can call video_analyze or video_transcribe on the saved file.

spec.name: video_download
spec.description: A video download tool that fetches a public video from a URL (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and hundreds of sites via yt-dlp) and saves the mp4 file INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only. Use whenever the user gives a video link that must be analyzed. Returns the saved workspace path plus video metadata (title, uploader, duration, resolution) so the next step can call video_analyze or video_transcribe on the saved file.

url.description: Public video page URL (http(s) only, e.g. TikTok/YouTube/Instagram link).

filename.description: Optional custom file name inside Workspace (single name, .mp4 added if missing).

tools.name: video_transcribe
tools.description: An asynchronous speech transcription tool that extracts audio from video files and transcribes speech into timestamped text. Use whenever a video contains spoken dialogue, interviews, or lectures that need verbatim transcription. Use this to extract accurate chronological dialogue and spoken facts from media files.

spec.name: video_transcribe
spec.description: An asynchronous speech transcription tool that extracts audio from video files and transcribes speech into timestamped text. Use whenever a video contains spoken dialogue, interviews, or lectures that need verbatim transcription. Use this to extract accurate chronological dialogue and spoken facts from media files.

job_id.description: Job ID to poll status. If provided, returns job status.

language.description: Language hint for transcription, e.g. ar, en. Default auto.

tools.name: vision_analyze
tools.description: A visual inspection tool that analyzes images AND video visual content using local vision models to extract visual details, text, and structure. Use whenever images (receipts, diagrams, UI mockups, photos) or videos (video files in Workspace, downloaded via video_download, or video frames via video_analyze) are provided or referenced in user requests. Use this to perform grounded visual reasoning directly without terminal workarounds.

spec.name: vision_analyze
spec.description: A visual inspection tool that analyzes images AND video visual content using local vision models to extract visual details, text, and structure. Use whenever images (receipts, diagrams, UI mockups, photos) or videos (video files in Workspace, downloaded via video_download, or video frames via video_analyze) are provided or referenced in user requests. Use this to perform grounded visual reasoning directly without terminal workarounds.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until one condition holds before continuing (spinner, late load, result appearing). On timeout returns the timeout plus the current page state.

spec.name: wait_for
spec.description: Wait until one condition holds before continuing (spinner, late load, result appearing). On timeout returns the timeout plus the current page state.

condition.description: text, text_gone, element_visible, element_hidden, url_contains, network_idle, new_tab, download_complete, console_message or seconds.

value.description: Value for the condition (text, url part, seconds count).

tools.name: workspace
tools.description: Your work device: list folders/files and create folders INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only. The context shows only the top level (folders as folder/ with item counts); call list with a folder path to enter it before reading anything inside. Every file, upload, or project lives inside Workspace — one new folder per project or task. Paths outside Workspace are BLOCKED.

spec.name: workspace
spec.description: Your work device: list folders/files and create folders INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only. The context shows only the top level (folders as folder/ with item counts); call list with a folder path to enter it before reading anything inside. Every file, upload, or project lives inside Workspace — one new folder per project or task. Paths outside Workspace are BLOCKED.

action.description: list: show one folder level. create_folder: make a new folder. delete_file: delete one file (also deletes its document embeddings).

path.description: Workspace-relative folder to list or create inside. Empty means the Workspace root.

name.description: Folder name for create_folder, or file name for delete_file.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: A filesystem modification tool that creates new files or replaces existing file contents INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only (any path outside is BLOCKED, but anything inside is open). Use whenever you need to write code, save generated reports, update configs, or store structured data on disk. Use this to implement concrete changes and persist verified outputs in the workspace.
